name: NRG Energy, Inc
moat_justification: Real scale and a sticky retail book, but the generation half is a commodity price-taker and retail switching costs are low; nothing here earns pricing power through a cycle. FOR: largest US retail electricity customer base plus the Vivint smart-home installed base; integrated generation-plus-retail natural hedge; post-LS Power fleet scale (~25 GW) in ERCOT and PJM; CPower VPP/demand-response platform; contracted BYOP data-center pipeline (1.2 GW hyperscaler CCGT, 15-yr term targeted). AGAINST: merchant generation is a pure commodity with no pricing power; retail churn is high and switching costs near zero; weather/commodity volatility dominates single years (OE negative FY2022 and FY2023); ERCOT/state regulatory exposure; post-LS Power leverage with a <3.0x net debt/EBITDA target 24-36 months out constraining the equity story.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 5.5%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Utilities sector — OE/capex DCF fits utilities names poorly; grade confidence low
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.1x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Real cash-generative power franchise but a weak 4/10 moat and hedge-noise OE; on the normalized base it does not clear 15% (weighted IRR 8.2%, IV@15 $43.17 vs $101.54 price) — even the super-bull tail falls short; it would need the low-$40s to clear 15% on standardized owner's earnings.
moat_for: Largest US retail electricity customer base (Reliant, Green Mountain, Direct Energy) plus Vivint smart-home installed base
Integrated generation-plus-retail structure is a partial natural hedge
Post-LS Power fleet scale (~25 GW) concentrated in ERCOT and PJM
CPower virtual-power-plant / demand-response platform — contracted, asset-light earnings
Contracted data-center pipeline (BYOP 1.2 GW hyperscaler CCGT, minimum 15-yr term targeted)
moat_against: Merchant generation is a pure commodity — no pricing power; market and regulators set prices
Retail electricity churn is high; switching costs near zero
Weather and commodity volatility dominate single years (OE negative in FY2022 and FY2023)
Regulatory/political exposure in ERCOT and state retail-choice politics
Post-acquisition leverage — targeting <3.0x net debt/Adj. EBITDA only over 24-36 months
